name: kml-update
description: UPDATE is a pattern-matched bulk mutation that never creates elements: shallow-merge SET ATTRIBUTES / SET METADATA, per-element update expressions (COALESCE / ADD / MUL / CLAMP), the {updated, matched} report, and the refusal to write reserved `_` metadata.
setup: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?drug_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Drug"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Pharmaceutical drug concept type" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?symptom_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Symptom"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Medical symptom concept type" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?treats_pred { {type: "$PropositionType", name: "treats"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Treatment relationship" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_setup", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?headache { {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "severity": "moderate", "duration": "2-4 hours" } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 1.0 } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?fever { {type: "Symptom", name: "Fever"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "temperature_range": "38-40°C", "common": true } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 0.9 } }

UPSERT { CONCEPT ?aspirin { {type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "molecular_formula": "C9H8O4", "risk_level": 2, "dosage": "325mg" } SET PROPOSITIONS { ("treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Headache"}) ("treats", {type: "Symptom", name: "Fever"}) } } } WITH METADATA { "source": "test_data", "confidence": 0.95 }

cases.name: the reinforcement idiom initializes and increments a counter
cases.command: UPDATE ?s SET ATTRIBUTES { observed_count: ADD(COALESCE(?s.attributes.observed_count, 0), 1), status: "active" } SET METADATA { last_review: "2026-06-11" } WHERE { ?s {type: "Symptom"} }

cases.name: the update wrote attributes, metadata and advanced _version
running the same update again increments the now-existing counter
cases.command: UPDATE ?s SET ATTRIBUTES { observed_count: ADD(COALESCE(?s.attributes.observed_count, 0), 1), status: "active" } SET METADATA { last_review: "2026-06-11" } WHERE { ?s {type: "Symptom"} }

cases.name: UPDATE never creates: an unmatched identity reports not found
cases.command: UPDATE ?x SET ATTRIBUTES { status: "ghost" } WHERE { ?x {type: "Drug", name: "Nonexistent"} }

cases.name: the decay idiom updates proposition metadata
cases.command: UPDATE ?link SET METADATA { confidence: CLAMP(MUL(COALESCE(?link.metadata.confidence, 1.0), 0.5), 0.0, 1.0) } WHERE { ?link ({type: "Drug", name: "Aspirin"}, "treats", ?o) }

cases.name: the decayed confidence is exactly half the original
a fully unconstrained pattern with a predicate-variable FILTER
cases.command: UPDATE ?link SET METADATA { decay_applied_at: "2026-07-05T00:00:00Z" } WHERE { ?link (?s, ?p, ?o) FILTER(?p != "belongs_to_domain") FILTER(?link.metadata.confidence > 0.3 && ?link.metadata.confidence < 1.0) } LIMIT 500
